svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Relay architecture
svg.desc: A local VS Code extension with a shared session lifecycle, desktop and phone clients, Claude and Codex adapters, scheduled tasks and a shared Chrome window. Based on the current working tree, including Mermaid rendering.
